missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Студент' is an animate masculine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Умный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'этот' points at him.
Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate noun. 'Студента' is the accusative object of 'знаю'; because the noun is animate masculine, its accusative copies the genitive form. 'Этого' agrees likewise.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Студента' is the genitive singular after 'у', framing whose book is missing. 'Нет учебника' uses the genitive of absence.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Студенту' is the dative singular governed by 'помог', which takes the dative. 'Преподаватель' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after the adjective. 'Студентом' is the instrumental singular governed by 'доволен', which takes the instrumental. 'Этим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Студенте' is the prepositional singular after 'о', expressing the topic. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a numeral. 'Студентов' is the genitive plural after 'пять'. 'В аудитории' adds the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural of animate nouns. 'Студентов' is the accusative plural, which for animate nouns copies the genitive plural. 'Всех' agrees in the animate accusative plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Студенты' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'читают'. 'Хорошие' agrees in the plural, and 'много' adds degree.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural after preposition. 'Студентами' is the instrumental plural after 'со' in 'встретиться с'. 'Декан' is the nominative subject.
